data.title: Fine notice for tailgating on the A1 (Bußgeldbescheid)
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Musterweiler – Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Johanna Beispielkamp for driving too close to the vehicle ahead at 112 km/h on the A1 on 19 March 2025. The total amount due is €128.50 and 1 point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister; an objection (Einspruch) can be filed within the deadline shown after delivery.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the district traffic fines office (Bußgeldstelle) for tailgating (Abstandsverstoß) on the motorway. It sets a €100 fine plus a €25 fee and €3.50 delivery costs, totaling €128.50, and adds 1 point to the driving record. You may accept it or object (Einspruch) if you dispute the accusation or penalty; the app shows the deadline for this, counted from the actual delivery date. If you object, a court could also decide against you. If you do not object, the fine becomes final and payment falls due by the deadline shown; late payment can lead to enforcement measures. Consider consulting a traffic lawyer if you wish to contest it.

key_facts.label: Violation (Verkehrsordnungswidrigkeit)
key_facts.quote: Sie hielten bei einer Geschwindigkeit von 112 km/h nicht den erforderlichen Abstand von einem vorausfahrenden Fahrzeug; der Abstand betrug weniger als 4/10 des halben Tachowertes.

key_facts.quote: Die Frist für den Einspruch beträgt zwei Wochen ab Zustellung; einzulegen ist er schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Kreisverwaltung Musterweiler – Bußgeldstelle.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the fine (Einspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file a written objection (Einspruch) against the fine, or file it in person at the Bußgeldstelle, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed, the fine becomes final (rechtskräftig); if you do object, a court is not bound by the fine set here and could also decide to your disadvantage.
